name: external-review
description: Ask local external coding agents for read-only review, critique, and second opinions using short repo-aware prompts.

interface.longDescription: Use External Review to ask local external coding agents for read-only code, plan, skill, and implementation critique. It keeps prompts short, lets the selected reviewer inspect the checkout itself, and records advisory evidence without acting as a task runner.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude for a read-only second opinion on this implementation
